data.Q: Why does Paul keep speaking so late?
data.A: Paul intends to leave the next day.

data.Q: Who intends to leave the next day?
What happens to Eutychus after he falls?
While Eutychus grows sleepy, who keeps speaking?
From where does Eutychus fall to the ground?
data.A: Eutychus falls from the third story.
data.wrong_answer: Eutychus falls from the upstairs room.

data.Q: How long does Paul go on speaking?
data.wrong_answer: Paul goes on until the next day.
